## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-*juǎn* prose commentary on the *[Shì Móhēyǎn lùn 釋摩訶衍論](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0084)* by the Sòng monk [普觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AE%E8%A7%80) (Pǔguān), paired with his structural outline *[Kē 科 (T773)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0088)*. The colophon attributes the work using the verb 述 ("to relate / expound"). The work is preserved only in the *Manji-zokuzōkyō* 卍續藏經 (X46). It is the longest of the seven Chinese / Liao sub-commentaries on the *Shì Móhēyǎn lùn* in the canon (six *juǎn*), surpassed in size only by the *[Liáo Tōngxuán chāo 通玄鈔](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0090)* by 志福 (four *juǎn*).

**Abstract**

The text proceeds *juǎn*-by-*juǎn* through the parent treatise, providing detailed prose commentary on each section. The author Pǔguān is also the compiler of [KR6o0088](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0088) (the structural outline on the same parent text); together these two works constitute his complete commentarial project on the *Shì Móhēyǎn lùn*. Pǔguān is otherwise poorly attested in standard biographical sources; internal evidence and the Sòng dynastic attribution place him loosely in the Northern or Southern Sòng period (1100–1200). His extensive treatment of the *Shì Móhēyǎn lùn* — both topical outline and running commentary — represents the most thorough Sòng-Chinese exegetical engagement with the text.
